tags: Nylon Sub-Rose Assembly for Omnia Brass Leversets

text.description_html:
Nylon Sub-Rose Assembly for Omnia Brass Leversets

Omnia nylon sub-rose assembly feature self-aligning thru-bolts and fits a standard 2-1/8" bore hole. Lever strength spring assisted inside and outside, for Door Levers only (Not for use with Door Knobs). For use with passage and privacy functions. Has a 7mm hub that fits 7mm Passage Spindle and 7mm Privacy Spindle.

*Note: Check Your Rose Design. This nylon sub-rose assembly is the standard model used with the following Omnia rose designs: 577 (beaded passage), 806 (beaded privacy), 579 (roped passage), 807 (roped privacy), 671 (traditional passage), 808 (traditional privacy), 811 (ribbon & reed passage) and 855 (ribbon & reed privacy).

For other Omnia rose designs use Omnia 982 Sub Rose.

For use with Omnia Brass Leversets only.

Specifications for the Omnia 983 Nylon Sub-Rose Cassette:

  • Diameter: 2-7/16"
  • Projection: 1/2"
  • Fits standard 2-1/8" Bore Hole
  • 7mm Square Hub (for 7mm Square Spindle)

Sold Individually



** Item Discontinued. Use the new Omnia 982 Sub Rose.
